purpose: Frozen Phase B roadmap, version 2. Supersedes phase-b-roadmap.v1.json, which is PRESERVED unmodified. The sole substantive change is replacing a RETRACTED finding that v1 still carried as live.
note: Timestamps are deliberately omitted: this package must be byte-reproducible. Ordering is established by git history.

globalRules.isolation: Every cell runs in its own dedicated clone or worktree with its own input and output directories. No cell writes to a path another cell reads. The primary checkout is never written.
globalRules.seeds: All stochastic procedures take their seed from experiments/preregistration.v1.json uncertainty.seed unless a cell declares otherwise in advance.
globalRules.predictionDiscipline: Each cell commits its prediction and falsifier to the audit package BEFORE the cell is executed. A result produced without a committed prediction is labelled RETROSPECTIVE CORROBORATION and may not be described as a test.
globalRules.adverseResultRetention: Null, negative and adverse results are retained and reported with the same prominence as favourable ones. No gate may be weakened, no threshold retuned, and no adverse finding removed.
globalRules.eligibilityDeclaration: Every cell MUST declare which eligible-state set it uses, and MUST report results under both [0..8] and [1..8] whenever the choice could move a ranking or an interval crossing. See finding F-B2-NEW-1.
globalRules.independenceRule: Any oracle claimed to be independent must not import repository model code, must derive its root from __file__, and must load the protocol rather than hard-code it. Mutual blindness between parallel cells requires one scratch directory per cell.
globalRules.claimStrength: Finite numerical search yields 'no better solution found over the declared domain', never 'proved global optimum'. Search domains are declared in advance.

stages.title: Mutation battery
stages.goal: Establish which false scientific claims the existing test suite and gate ledger can actually detect. A surviving mutation is a region where the repository could publish a wrong result and stay green.

mutations.target: species label swap between E. coli behavioural and Salmonella/Bacillus structural evidence
truth class - relabel a synthetic or reconstructed source as OBSERVED
mutations.expectedDetector: export validator; NOTE this is already known weak, see Phase A finding on truthClassForMode

mutations.target: censoring treatment - include right-censored dwells in the uncensored likelihood

mutations.expectedDetector: hard throw at lib/observed-experiment.js motor-leakage check

mutations.target: experimental-unit count inflation - count events as independent units
mutations.expectedDetector: X02; NOTE the X02A/X02B/X02S contract bears directly on this
tests/walkthrough.test.mjs hash pins; C2f showed the cross-study report gate will NOT detect this

mutations.target: adverse-result removal - delete the lognormal advantage from the report
prospective prediction ordering - compute a prediction after revealing the outcome
physical work vs variational free energy conflation, including unit mixing

stages.method: Apply each mutation in a dedicated disposable clone. Run the full declared gate set. Record DETECTED or SURVIVED with the detecting file and line, or the absence of one. Revert by force checkout and confirm restoration by raw on-disk hash before the next mutation.
stages.prediction: TO BE COMMITTED PER MUTATION BEFORE EXECUTION.
stages.deliverable: audits/phase-b/b1-mutation-ledger.json with one row per mutation and a programmatic count of detectors fired.

stages.title: Serious model competition
stages.precondition: B2 established that M3 is fitted to the best located optimum, so comparisons against M3 are not comparisons against a mis-fit model. This precondition is now SATISFIED. Additionally, b3-integration-addendum-v3.json governs all cross-specification conflicts, and b3-preflight.py must PASS before predictions are committed.
stages.goal: Compare the UNI two-timescale mixture against serious alternatives on identical motor-level splits and identical scoring rules, separating predictive superiority from mechanistic identity.
baselines: flexible finite mixture with k > 2 components
at least one credible non-UNI mechanistic alternative
scoringRules: held-out mean log predictive density per event, in nats
at least one strictly proper alternative scoring rule to check rank stability
stages.uncertainty: Motor-cluster nonparametric bootstrap, seed from the protocol, percentile 95 percent interval. Report interval crossings explicitly.
stages.mandatoryConstraint: The current adverse lognormal result must remain visible in the output whether it is confirmed or overturned. If a richer model overtakes the lognormal, that must be reported alongside, not instead of, the existing finding.
stages.deliverable: audits/phase-b/b3-model-competition.json with a full leaderboard, intervals, and an explicit statement of what predictive superiority does and does not establish about mechanism.

stages.title: Identifiability and robustness
stages.goal: Determine which conclusions are properties of the data and which are artifacts of specification choices.
components: parameter recovery in a correctly specified synthetic world with known ground truth
parameter recovery in misspecified synthetic worlds
sensitivity to alternative priors where any are used
sensitivity to seed across many bootstrap seeds
sensitivity to censoring assumptions, including treating right-censored dwells as observed and as fully censored
sensitivity to outlier rules and to the analysisStartIndex 3500 boundary
sensitivity to binning and to the eligible-state choice [0..8] versus [1..8] per F-B2-NEW-1
measurement-uncertainty propagation from the 0.02 s sampling interval
stages.deliverable: audits/phase-b/b4-identifiability-robustness.json with a sensitivity table naming every conclusion that moves and every conclusion that does not.

stages.title: Prospective experimental design
stages.criticalRule: REPLAY IS NOT PROSPECTIVE. Nothing in this repository is currently prospective, because every preregistration entered version control in the same commit as its results and there are no signed tags or external timestamps. B5 produces a FUTURE contract, not a claim about existing evidence.
stages.goal: Produce a frozen, externally anchorable contract for an experiment that could discriminate between UNI and its serious alternatives, prioritising designs that could make UNI FAIL.
requiredContents: the competing models and their point of maximum disagreement
the intervention and the physical variable manipulated
the experimental unit and why it is independent
frozen predictions with uncertainty, committed before observation
the preregistered analysis, including the exact scoring rule
an external timestamping mechanism, since git history alone cannot establish prospectivity
stages.prediction: Not applicable. B5 produces predictions; it does not test one.
stages.deliverable: audits/phase-b/b5-prospective-contract.v1.json, externally timestamped by a mechanism outside this repository before any corresponding observation is revealed.

orderingConstraints: B1 is independent of B3/B4/B5 and may run at any time.
B3 required B2 to establish that M3 is correctly fitted. That precondition is satisfied.
B4 should follow B3, because its sensitivity table is most informative when applied to a leaderboard rather than to a single model.
B5 should follow B3 and B4, because the region of maximum model disagreement is an output of those stages, not an input.

changeLog.change: Replaced open item F-B2-NEW-1 with F-B2-REV-1.
changeLog.reason: F-B2-NEW-1 asserted that state 0 was excluded with no authorizing rule. That was FALSE and was retracted in b2-correction-addendum-2.json: state 0 has 18 uncensored holdout events against the frozen H1 threshold of 20, so it fails a preregistered criterion. v1 continued to carry the retracted text with status "awaiting decision", leaving the package internally inconsistent.
